Commentary.Commentary: Alastair Cook has decided that they will bat and set a target for the visiting side. Do join us in a bit as we have the two English openers sharing the crease.

After Moeen Ali took the wicket of Misbah on 52, it was all about Wahab who kept playing his big strokes and tried his best to reduce the gap of their large trail. Eventually, Ali took his wicket too. The hosts have decided to bat despite Pakistan trailing by 391. A bizarre call from the home side.

Finally, England have managed to wrap up the Pakistani 1st innings. The 9th wicket stand between Misbah and Wahab nearly made England fight for 15 overs after Lunch to give away their wicket. The duo stitched 60 runs together by playing sensibly and hitting away the loose balls.

It was Stokes who took the price wicket of Sarfraz and then Woakes got Yasir on the second last ball before lunch.  Let's see what we have in store for us, will it be Pakistan getting all out and follow-on? Or some sheer resistance since Mishab is at the crease. Do join us after for the post-lunch session.

Once again, England dominated by picking up 4 wickets. Pakistan are reeling on 118/8 with Misbah-ul-Haq fighting alone in this long battle. In England's bowling unit, all the seamers picked a wicket each in this early morning session. Sarfraz and Misbah did show some resistance in their 36 runs partnership after Masood and Shafiq left the crease early.

Catch No. 4 for Root and wicket No. 4 for Woakes as England squeeze in another wicket before Lunch!

The players and umpires are making their way out to the middle. It's up to England to continue their bowling onslaught and Pakistan to withstand it. SHAN MASOOD and MISBAH-UL-HAQ to resume the batting and JAMES ANDERSON to start the bowling proceedings.

The forecast doesn't look to be too conducive and we can only hope for a full day of cricket. The visitors will try their best to avoid a follow-on and the pitch has proven quite batting friendly, but will it be enough to see the beleaguered side through? Join us for some live coverage and find out.

Hello and welcome to Day 3 of the 2nd Test between England and Pakistan. England declared their innings post Tea yesterday, putting up an enormous score for the visitors to follow. They had a very hard time of it in the final session with the packers rocking the Pakistan top-order.
.....Day 3, Session 1.....

Pakistan saw the new-ball pair of Broad and Anderson  but it was the duo of Woakes and Stokes who did the real damage. In their combined spell of 10 overs, they picked up 4 wickets with a meagre score of 57/4. The visiting side is certainly on the back foot with Masood being unbeaten on 30 with sheer resistance with the new man Misbah at the other end. Shall have to wait and watch how they fare on Day 3. Do join us for this real Test cricketing action tomorrow at 1530 IST as it gets intense from here on. Until then, take care, adios and goodbye.

That was very much England's day on the field. After a towering score of 589 with the likes of run machine Root's double ton and too many handy fifties by other Englishmen, all hosts had to do was to bowl well in the final session and pick up a few wickets.

Back of a length outside off, defended to the off side.
Full ball around off, blocked off the front foot to the batsmen.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Masood has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
AZHAR ALI is the next man in.

OUT! First over, first wicket for Woakes! Length ball outside off, Hafeez falls for the temptation as the ball angles away. He tries to defend it but the ball takes an outside edge. From there, it's a sitter for Root at second slip who comfortably pouches it. That's one down for Pakistan!
FOUR! Hafeez made that look easy! Short ball down the leg side, Hafeez works it to the fine leg boundary. Maybe the ball didn't swing the way Woakes wanted it to.
Length ball outside off, punched to the covers.
Length ball around off, Hafeez blocks it off the back foot with the full face of the bat.
Length ball outside off, seaming away from the batsman, Hafeez lets it through.
Back of a length outside off, left alone.
CHRIS WOAKES into the attack.
On off, worked to the leg side.
No ball! Moeen tosses up a full toss that loops a mile over the batsman's head.
Outside off, defended off the front foot.
Landed outside off, defended to the off side.
Pitched on the pads, blocked back to the bowler.
FOUR! First boundary for Shan! Loopy ball outside off, Masood cuts it nicely through the covers and finds the fence.
Tossed up outside off, cut to the covers for a single.
MOEEN ALI to roll his arm now!
Full on the stumps, defended to the leg side.
Length ball on middle and off, flicked to backward square leg for a single.
Length ball and swinging it away from the batsman, it is left alone. How much longer can the batsmen resist the temptation?
Length ball outside off and angling away a bit, Hafeez leaves it.
Good length delivery outside off, an easy leave.
Short ball outside off, Hafeez shoulders his arms.
Shortish ball on middle, Hafeez gently nudges it to square leg for a single.
Back of a length and outside off, left alone.
Short ball around off, blocked with the full face of the bat to the off side.
Shorter ball around off, awkwardly defended to the off side.
Full ball around off, Hafeez looks to drive it but gets an inside edge to mid-wicket.
Bouncer! It's a slower ball on the stumps and is not a challenge for Hafeez to duck under.
Short ball outside off, Masood decides not to play it at the last moment.
Short ball outside off, a cramped Masood is forced to lift his arms again.
Length ball a tad outside off, Masood lets it through.
Good length delivery outside off, defended to point.
Short ball outside off, left alone.
Length ball outside off, Masood shoulders his arms.
Length ball around off, defended back to the bowler. Good over, a well-deserved maiden!
Short ball outside off, left alone.

A huge appeal! Length ball around off and angling in, Hafeez looks to defend it off the front foot. The fielding side screams an appeal but the umpire is not interested. The fielders clamour for a review but Cook disagrees. The replay shows that he made the right decision as the ball hits the pads first but went on to clearly miss the leg stump.
Bouncer on middle, Hafeez is sent ducking again, this time more uncomfortable for the batsman.
Bouncer! Around off, Hafeez ducks early to avoid it.
Back of a length ball outside off, left alone.
Pitched around off and swinging away, Masood lifts his arms once more.
Outside off and Masood shoulders his arms.
Length ball around off, defended from within the crease.
Back of a length and outside off, angling away sharply, Masood leaves it.
Good length delivery outside off, swinging away, left alone.
Short ball a tad outside off, defended to the off side.
BEATEN! Length ball outside off, Hafeez tries to defend it but misses and the ball goes just past his outside edge.
Length ball around off, pushed to the covers.
FOUR! Hafeez hits it hard! Shortish ball outside off, Hafeez slashes it through the covers and the ball whizzes it's way to the boundary line.
Length ball outside off, veering inwards, Hafeez makes a good leave.
Short ball outside off, Hafeez gets on his toes and plays that with soft hands to point.
Shortish ball outside off, Hafeez steps forward and then shoulders his arms.
Fullish around off, blocked back to the bowler.
Length ball around off, defended to the leg side with a straight bat to the leg side. Quality defensive batting by Masood!
Fullish on middle and off, Masood defends it to the off side.
Fuller around off, Masood gets on the front foot and blocks it with the full face of his bat.
Length ball outside off, angled away, Masood thinks twice and leaves it.
Length ball on off, Masood defends it from within the crease.
Outside off, Hafeez leaves it.
FOUR! SQUARE DRIVEN! Full outside off, Hafeez is perfectly balanced as he drives it through the covers and the ball zips to the ropes.
Short ball a tad outside off, swinging in gently, Hafeez shoulders his arms.
Length ball on middle and off, defended back to the bowler.
Short ball down the leg, Masood looks to work it and is hit on the pads. The ball travels to fine leg for a single and the umpire signals a leg bye.
Short ball around off, Masood stands tall and defends it to the leg side.
Masood shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot for a single.
Length ball outside off and the ball shapes away and misses the batsman's defence and to the keeper once more.
Full around off, Masood gets off the marks with a neat flick to square leg for a brace.
Similar ball and this time Masood lets it through.
Outside off and shaping away again, Masood tries to defend it but it moves away to the keeper.
BEATEN! Length ball around off, the ball shapes away and the ball nearly takes an edge off Masood's defence!
Fuller ball on the pads, hastily defended to the leg side.
Good length delivery, wider off the crease, defended off the front foot to point.
Length ball outside off, swinging in, Hafeez shoulders his arms. That's a good call!
Full on the stumps, defended to the off side off the front foot by Hafeez.
Down the leg side again, Hafeez looks to flick it but misses and the keeper rushes to collect it.
Length ball down the leg side, Hafeez lets it go past.
STUART BROAD will share the new cherry from the other end.
Short ball outside off, Masood wisely shoulders his arms.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Masood has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Short ball on middle and leg, Masood looks to defend it but gets a leading edge that nearly carries to the slips for a catch! Drama in the first over!
Length ball outside off, superbly driven through the covers for a triple. A nice way for Pakistan to get off the mark!
Fuller around off with a little bit of shape, defended off the front foot.
